claim: Imperial Treasure, Jiang by Chef Fei, and Taian Table have held 2 Michelin stars continuously since 2020, 2019, and 2021 respectively; no Guangzhou restaurant has ever earned 3 stars
quote: As of the 2024 Michelin Guide, no restaurants in Guangzhou hold three Michelin stars. The highest rating achieved is two stars.

claim: The 2025 Michelin Guide Guangzhou features 112 recommended restaurants: 3 two-star, 18 one-star, 45 Bib Gourmand, 46 Michelin-Selected
quote: The 2025 selection features a total of 112 outstanding restaurants, including 3 Two Star establishments, 18 One Star venues, 45 Bib Gourmand eateries.

claim: The 2025 Michelin Guide Guangzhou (8th edition) was released on July 2, 2025; all previously starred establishments retained their status
quote: The 2025 Michelin Guide Guangzhou was officially released on July 2, marking its eighth year. 112 restaurants were featured.

claim: All three 2-star restaurants (Imperial Treasure, Jiang by Chef Fei, Taian Table) retained their ratings in the 2025 guide with no changes at the top tier
quote: 21 restaurants retained their Michelin Stars from last year.

claim: Imperial Treasure Fine Chinese Cuisine Guangzhou is at L514B, 5/F, IGC Mall, 222 Xingmin Road, Tianhe; open daily 11:00–14:30 and 17:30–22:00; phone +86 20 3885 6382
quote: L514B, 5/F, International Grand City, No. 222 Xing Min Road, Tianhe District, Guangzhou 510623. Hours: Daily 11:00-14:30, 17:30-22:00.

claim: Jiang by Chef Fei is at 3F, Mandarin Oriental, 389 Tianhe Road; lunch Mon–Fri 11:30–14:30, Sat–Sun 10:00–15:00; dinner daily 17:30–22:00; phone +86 20 3808 8885
quote: 389 Tianhe Road, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, China. Arguably the city's finest Cantonese restaurant. Two MICHELIN Stars for seven consecutive years.

claim: Taian Table Guangzhou serves 10-course (¥1,998) or 12-course (¥2,388) tasting menus plus 10% service charge; Wed–Sat dinner only; ¥1,000 deposit/person required; wine pairing available
quote: Base pricing: ¥1,998 (10 courses) and ¥2,388 (12 courses). 10% Service Charge is added to the final bill. Open from Wednesday to Saturday for dinner only. Deposit of RMB 1,000 per guest.

claim: Taian Table Guangzhou was founded by chef Stefan Stiller and offers five curated tasting menus per year (four seasonal plus one Best Of menu)
quote: Starting this year, five menus are offered annually: four seasonal menus plus one Best of menu highlighting standout dishes.

claim: Chef Huang Jinghui (Chef Fei) started his culinary career at 16, became executive chef at 20, and has over 30 years of experience; signature Steamed Hele Crab with minced pork uses Hainan crab
quote: Chef Huang Jinghui (Chef Fei) began his culinary career at 16 and became an executive chef by 20. With over 30 years of experience, he's renowned for creative Cantonese cuisine.

claim: Taian Table Guangzhou has 22 seats around an open kitchen counter; the tasting menu features otoro tuna tartar, clam ceviche, lobster, foie gras, and wagyu; wine pairing costs ¥825–¥1,285
quote: This intimate 22-seat restaurant. The signature eight-course menu costs RMB1,488 plus 10% service charge. Wine pairings range from RMB825 (fine) to RMB1,285 (premium).

claim: Jiang by Chef Fei earned a 2026 Asia 100 Fine Dining Diamond award; signature dishes include glass crispy roasted pigeon, braised geoduck, loofah soup dumplings, and Quinoa-flavored mantis shrimp
quote: Michelin recognition (2026 Asia 100 - Fine Dining Diamond award). Braised geoduck steak, glass crispy roasted pigeon, pistachio foie gras.

claim: Imperial Treasure IGC interior was designed by a Japanese space design firm; private dining rooms available; signature dim sum includes golden net crispy shrimp rice rolls and honey-glazed BBQ pork pastry
quote: The environment is super photogenic, designed by a famous Japanese space design firm. Private dining rooms available.
